findings.title: driver_declarations / driving_exams anon USING(true)
findings.rootCause: Anon SELECT/UPDATE policies used USING(true); client .eq(token) is not an RLS bound.
findings.changeMade: Dropped anon USING(true) policies; added SECURITY DEFINER token RPCs; SignDeclaration and TakeDrivingExam use RPCs.

findings.title: Mutable company_name / is_active on profiles
findings.rootCause: profiles UPDATE allowed any column for id=auth.uid(); session restore skipped is_active.
findings.changeMade: BEFORE UPDATE trigger locks company_name/is_active/approval/2FA except service_role and super_admin; Settings no longer submits company_name; AuthContext signs out inactive sessions; edgeAuth rejects inactive users.
